function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT period, sku, SUM(qty) AS total_qty, SUM(unit_cost_cad * qty) / SUM(qty) AS avg_unit_cost_cad
FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line
WHERE period IN ('2026-08', '2026-09')
GROUP BY period, sku","purpose":"Average unit cost per SKU per period from purchase_line"}
